main_text.p: Praecepti aureum ad vitam proroga-dam. naturam tributam effe rationem, vt nocitura declinet, profutura vero ampleſtatur, vtque triqueac gulae conftanter imperet, ne prae-ter modum & intempeftiue iis vefcatur, in quibus plus voluptatis, quam vtilitatis in-effe deprehenditur. Vitam enim falubriter prorogare cupienti, duo inprimis confide-randa funt; primum: praeferuare corpus à praepoftera ficcitate, deinde vitare nimium ac immodicum, intempeftiuumq; rarefacti-entium, hoc eft, folidam compactamq; ma-teriam difiungentium ac relaxantium vfum; Duo in primis circa vi-tam pro-ducen-dam ani-maduer-tenda. hac enim quia plurimum calida funt tenuif-que fubftantiae, alte penetrant, humorefque per refolutionem & euaporationem tenui-ores partium à craffioribus & terreftribus abfu-muntur, vnde tandem corpus exiccari ac con-tabefcere neceffario contingit.

Peffime igitur fanitati confulunt, qui ventriculo relaxato, debili & imbecillo ad-Male fa-ciunt qui ventricu-lo rela-xato de-bili ad-hibent relaxantia, vt maluaticum, piper, fi-napi, theriacam, mitridaticum, & fimilia, iifque quae vires proftratas vel languidas recuperare re ftudent & corroborare, cum potius aftrin-gentia & auftera, quae fc.corrugando vnien-do; ventriculi villos, calorem congregent, ejaculando diffolutionem impediant, appetitu-que excitent, fint vfurpanda. Atq; haec monuif-hic & meminifle, quoniam inter meditandum ita occurrebant, ftudiofe volui, vt lector &c.

page.notes: Scan is a skewed photograph of a printed page; the right-hand column is partly cut off at the margin and the lower lines are faint, so several readings are uncertain. Marginal note words in the left margin are abbreviated and partly illegible; the note transcriptions above are approximate. The text at the bottom right and the ends of several right-hand lines are not legible enough to copy reliably. Word-level readings in the second paragraph, especially the tail of the last line, are doubtful and should be checked against the scan.
